title: Rendering and metadata
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one complete desktop Rendering and metadata subpage design for Ferromark, in a coordinated eight-page library website design suite.

INPUT ROLES:
Image 1 is the previously accepted Ferromark "Rendering and metadata" subpage, the EDIT TARGET and information/content hierarchy reference. Preserve its useful reading structure, clear code and data, semantics and section order.
Image 2 is the approved final warm Ferromark homepage, the EXACT VISUAL FAMILY REFERENCE. Match its warm beige paper fibers, matte pewter, rust-brown oxide, warm dark ink, grotesk type, margins, restrained functional rules, small product logo and refined mechanical materials. This is the selected direction, not an opportunity to invent another palette or theme.

COMMON FAMILY RULES:
Light theme only. Refined precision engineering, warm and technically literate, never brutal or dirty. Palette roles: paper #F4F0E6, inlay #FBFAF6, pewter #DCDDD6, ink #29362F, muted #5C655B, accent #88492F.
Use a continuous very light warm-paper reading ground with restrained fine fiber texture. A broad, very light matte-pewter evidence/reference surface may organize one meaningful major figure. Texture illumination is a subtle physical material effect, not a floating color gradient or decorative glow. Paper-white inlays keep small code, tables and notes clear.
Retain the approved homepage's humanist industrial sans/grotesk typography, moderate weights, open leading and generous horizontal gutters. Monospace is for code and exact data. Keep the top navigation and footer in the same family as Image 2, including its existing small product symbol with a real wordmark. The logo should read at an ordinary 32–64px display size, not as a tiny speck.
Documentation pages use a practical narrow left navigation rail and a generous main reading/code column. The homepage's small introductory margin can inform explanatory sections when helpful, but never add a second competing left rail that squeezes the code. Similar content receives the same treatment in both products: installation specimen, code result, reference table, measurement figure, trust note, next-step links.
Use ample vertical whitespace and reading line lengths. No decorative horizontal lines between every story, heavy borders, repeated card grids, dark sections, dirty rust, woodgrain, photo walls or ornate bolt framing. Functional table rules and navigation cues remain quiet and purposeful. Numbering is appropriate only for a real ordered procedure. Do not shrink long code or notes into unreadable microtype.
The hero instrument must retain a derivable purpose: Ferromark registers a source document with HTML and a metadata leaf; Ferroni compares pattern cassettes over a text ribbon and locates the next match. Preserve the actual reference instrument identity. No invented unrelated metal objects.

PAGE-SPECIFIC DIRECTION:
A worked technical explainer. Retain the meaningful annotated document-register hero with Source / HTML / Metadata relationships, and the three-column Markdown / HTML / raw metadata specimen. Use the approved narrow left introductory notes for subsequent prose and policy sections, aligned to one wide main content column. Preserve every semantic explanation, table and limit. Remove repeated ornamental macro photographs from the lower body; replace those image slots with reading space, concise margin introductions and the existing semantic content. Use one broad very light pewter policy/reference spread behind both margin and main content; keep other content on warm paper. Raw front matter is extracted text; never claim YAML/TOML parsing.

TEXT AND EVIDENCE:
Use the exact source copy below for facts, code, API names, numbers and recorded conditions. Do not invent performance, compatibility, security, version or usage claims. Do not repeat incidental generated glyph errors from Image 1 when they conflict with this copy. This is a visual comp; source files remain authoritative.
# Rendering and metadata

A document becomes HTML, structure and the metadata around it.

## One document, distinct outputs

Markdown source:
---

title: Release notes
---

# Installation

A useful note.[^detail]

[^detail]: Details belong here.

Output responsibilities:
HTML: document markup and optional heading IDs
Metadata: raw front matter and document structure
Your application: YAML/TOML interpretation, routing and styling

## What the engine gives you

Front matter is extracted as text, not parsed as YAML or TOML.
Heading IDs and footnotes are publishing features you configure.
Rendering hooks connect your own output decisions.

## Recognition is not permission

API | Default | For untrusted input
Rust | Raw HTML passthrough | Enable sanitize
Node.js | Escaped raw HTML, filtered URL schemes | Keep renderPolicy: 'untrusted'

Custom renderer hooks and highlighter HTML are written verbatim. They must escape untrusted values themselves.

## Profiles and limits

Specification profiles disable publishing extras. Block nesting defaults to 100 levels; exceeding the limit returns a parse error.
